report.summary: Successfully implemented complete dependency-free Node.js ESM inventory CLI with all required features. All 10 acceptance tests pass with exit code 0.
evidence: Created cli.mjs, lib/store.mjs, and lib/inventory.mjs with full ESM implementation
Test run: 10 tests pass, 0 fail, exit code 0

All contract requirements implemented: item registration with SKU/NAME validation, stock receive/reserve/release/ship operations, aggregate reporting, strict identifier and quantity validation, JSON persistence, error handling preserves storage
Manual verification confirms: empty reads don't create files, errors exit nonzero, storage unchanged after rejected commands, operations persist across processes
SKU pattern validation: ^[A-Z][A-Z0-9-]*$, quantity validation: positive integers without leading zeros or exponent notation, NAME validation: non-whitespace required
Stock operations correctly enforce constraints: reserve limited by available stock (onHand-reserved), release/ship limited by reserved stock, overflow detection for MAX_SAFE_INTEGER
Independent store isolation confirmed with separate INVENTORY_FILE values
